notes: Sibling project to ../esp8266-tilt-prototype/, same three user-supplied breakouts (TP4056, GY-291, MCP9808) originally, but on a generic ESP32 Dev Kit V1 instead of an ESP8266 D1 Mini. Firmware needed almost no porting -- the production board's own fermentation_tilt_v1.ino already targets a bare ESP32 with the same GPIO numbers this design uses (4, 21, 22, 25, 34); only the battery-sense path changed (ungated, single-stage 100k/100k divider vs the production board's gated divider). Both known netlistsvg/elkjs rendering crash patterns discovered during the ESP8266 rig's development (NOCONNECT-vs-typed-pin-wired-to-NC; single driver fanning into two same-part inputs) were fixed proactively in mcu_core.py and sensor_bus.py, so the schematic SVG/PDF generated clean on the first attempt. REVISION: MCP9808 removed, DHT11 added as the only temperature sensor (user request -- has a DHT11 on hand instead of the probe). This was NOT a wiring-only swap like MCP9808<->DS18B20 is on the sibling rigs: DHT11 needed its own firmware library (Adafruit 'DHT sensor library' + 'Adafruit Unified Sensor'), its own read function, and moved off the I2C bus onto its own pin (GPIO4, previously NOCONNECT/unused). sensor_bus.py now carries only the GY-291; a new dht11.py block was added. mcu_core.py's GPIO4 pin changed from NOCONNECT to a real BIDIR signal -- re-verified this doesn't regress either proactive netlistsvg fix (schematic still generates clean). Firmware re-compiled clean against esp32:esp32 core 3.3.12, board esp32doit-devkit-v1 (85% flash, 15% RAM, essentially unchanged from before the swap). DHT11 is less accurate than the MCP9808 it replaced (+-2C vs +-0.5C, integer-only resolution) -- documented as a real tradeoff, not a defect. Hardware is entirely unverified pending a photo of the actual board -- see architecture/design_risks.md's note on ESP32 Dev Kit V1 pin-layout variance across vendors and the DHT11's two physical variants (3-pin breakout with onboard pull-up vs bare 4-pin needing an external one). No physical build/mounting guide yet (SPEC.md scopes that out for now, unlike the ESP8266 rig's Prototype Shield guide) -- add one if requested.
